data.body:
[P2] Revisit the duplicated test setup under Rule 2

This adds another `RunnerCallbacks` and HTTP delivery implementation alongside the equivalent bridge in `agentcore_worker_composed_test.py`. The description says the setup is copied, but does not explain which simpler options were considered or why they do not work, as Rule 2 (“Simplify before you add”), item 5 requires. Maintaining separate bridges lets their callback and transport behavior drift. Please return to the design phase under Rule 8, step 6, and consider sharing the existing bridge, documenting why duplication is necessary if that remains the chosen approach.
